limitations: This source/image follow-up is not a new full R1/R2, Cloud Run or production acceptance.
No active connected-Demo trading or new natural fills are performed on this image.
The preceding failed f4 short probe is retained as failed; new results never reclassify it.
Before/after windows run sequentially on a changing host; latency differences are not an exclusive causal benchmark.
Reserved worker/admission capacity does not guarantee latency under shared CPU, database, transport or operations-lane delays.
Matching the load ledger and recovered probes do not prove continuously working quotes or absence of every long-term memory leak.

Preparation contains one actual owner-state FOR UPDATE timeout and automatic engine restart before the timed hour. Its blocker/trigger is unproven; passing the hour does not reclassify startup as clean.
